summary: Master renewable energy project development with feasibility, finance, risk, and delivery tools. Learn through practical exercises and ready-to-use templates.
lede: Renewable energy project development training covers feasibility, resource screening, project finance and delivery planning. It is designed for professionals already involved in renewable projects who need to assess opportunities and guide them toward delivery, with practice in creating feasibility screens, testing financial assumptions, and planning execution, risk controls, commissioning and handover.
audienceIntro: This course is built for people who already work with renewable energy projects and need a stronger method for moving from concept to bankable delivery.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software, basic project examples if available, and an openness to work through feasibility, finance, and delivery templates. No programming is required, and AI-related content is covered at the level of practical awareness and operational use rather than technical model building.
